releaseNotes:
🔐 Change your password right in the app: Settings → Account → Change Password - no email needed
👥 Admins: manage team members from Settings → Account, tap anyone to edit
➕ One "Add / Invite User" button - invited people get a set-password email
🔄 Enquiries list now updates live - new enquiries and status changes appear instantly
💰 Amounts show as 50000, not 50000.0
🔔 Push notifications fixed - status changes and assignments reach the right people, once
📊 New analytics: Pipeline, Team, Money, Trends and Breakdown tabs
⚠️ Everyone must update to keep receiving notifications
features: NEW: Change Password in Settings → Account asks for your current and new password - no reset email needed
NEW: Settings → Account → Team members (admins) - tap a person to edit name, phone, role or deactivate
IMPROVED: Adding people always goes through invite, so every new user gets a working login
NEW: Enquiries list updates live - no need to pull to refresh
NEW: Analytics tabs - Overview, Pipeline (funnel, lost reasons, speed to lead), Team, Money, Trends, Breakdown and Tables
NEW: Count analytics by enquiry date or event date
NEW: Lost-reason sheet when an enquiry is marked Not Interested, Closed Lost or Cancelled
NEW: Calls and WhatsApp from an enquiry are recorded as contacts (first contact, last contact, count)
NEW: Admins can record quoted amount and quote date
IMPROVED: Tapping a notification opens the enquiry; in-app banner with a View button when the app is open
IMPROVED: Status colours are the same on every screen
bugFixes: Fixed being unable to change your password when the reset email does not arrive
Fixed "Add User" creating profiles that could not sign in
Fixed Enquiries list showing old statuses until refreshed
Fixed list jumping back to the top after opening an enquiry
Fixed amounts showing a trailing .0 in the edit form, history and CSV export
Fixed status-change and assignment notifications not being delivered
Fixed duplicate notifications and being notified about your own changes
Fixed status sheet staying open after changing a status
Fixed lost reason showing as a raw code in the change history
